welcome.zh:
欢迎！PSY100Y5 是心理学导论。心理学（**psychology**）就是研究行为和心理过程的科学。本站目前收录测验 2 的三章，讲的都是你每天都在经历的事：
第 4 章：眼睛、耳朵、皮肤、舌头和鼻子怎样把光、声音、压力和化学物质变成神经信号（感觉），大脑又怎样把这些信号整理成一个有意义的世界（知觉）。
第 5 章：意识是什么；我们为什么要睡觉、做梦；药物、催眠和冥想怎样改变意识。
第 6 章：经验怎样改变行为：巴甫洛夫的狗、斯金纳箱，还有看别人就能学会。
不用怕：这门课没有先修要求，几乎不用数学（只有第 4 章的韦伯定律要算一点比例），例子全是生活里的：咖啡、熬夜、手机、宠物、考试。真正的难点是英文：三章一共大约 260 个术语，测验全用英文。所以本站先用大白话中文把每个概念讲懂，再把要认、要写的英文句子单独给你背。测验 2（LEC0101 和 LEC0102）在 11 月 16 日周一考，50 分钟：30 道教材选择题，加上讲课内容的简答题。6 次测验里，选择题和简答题各去掉最低的一次，所以一次没考好也不是世界末日。本站目前只有第 4–6 章。一小节一小节来，你能学会。
welcome.en:
Welcome! PSY100Y5 is Introduction to Psychology, and **psychology** is the scientific study of behaviour and mental processes. The station covers the three chapters of Test 2, and all of them are about things you live through every day:
Chapter 4: how your eyes, ears, skin, tongue and nose turn light, sound, pressure and chemicals into nerve signals (sensation), and how your brain organizes those signals into a meaningful world (perception).
Chapter 5: what consciousness is, why we sleep and dream, and how drugs, hypnosis and meditation change consciousness.
Chapter 6: how experience changes behaviour, from Pavlov's dogs and the Skinner box to learning by watching others.
Do not be afraid: the course has no prerequisites, there is almost no maths (only a little proportion work for Weber's law in Chapter 4), and the examples come from daily life: coffee, late nights, phones, pets and exams. The real challenge is English: about 260 terms in three chapters, and every test is in English. So this site first explains each idea in plain Chinese and then gives you the English sentences to recognize and write. Test 2 for LEC0101 and LEC0102 is on Monday Nov 16: 50 minutes, 30 multiple-choice questions on the textbook plus short answers on the lectures. Across the six tests, your lowest multiple-choice score and your lowest short-answer score are dropped, so one bad test is not the end. The station covers Chapters 4-6 so far. Go one small section at a time. You can do this.

howToUse.zh: 先看下面的「知识地图」：三章是三条主线（第 4 章感觉与知觉、第 5 章意识、第 6 章学习），下面还有一条贯穿三章的线：大脑与神经系统（第 3 章，本站没有收录）。再记住测验 2 分两半：选择题考教材，对应每章前面标着「教材 Textbook」页码的小节；简答题考讲课，对应每章最后一节「讲课重点（简答题）」。
howToUse.en: Start with The big picture below: three branches (Chapter 4 sensation and perception, Chapter 5 consciousness, Chapter 6 learning) and one thread under all three, the brain and nervous system (Chapter 3, not in this station). Then remember that Test 2 has two halves: the multiple choice is on the textbook, which the sections with Textbook page numbers teach, and the short answers are on the lectures, which the last section of each chapter, Lecture review for short answers, teaches.

howToUse.zh: 在「学习 Learn」里按顺序读每一章。小节顺序和教材一样，每节都标着「教材 Textbook」页码，可以对着书看。每个概念按“是什么 → 生活类比 → 教材定义 → 拆开讲 → 例子 → 易错点 → 小测验”一小步一小步讲。每节有一个标签：「高频考点 High-yield」最常考，「必会 Must know」是后面内容的基础；这三章没有「了解 Background」小节。标签是本站根据教材和讲课做的判断，不是老师公布的范围。读懂一节就点「我学会了 Mark as learned」；每章最后的「考点清单」列出这一章最可能怎么考。
howToUse.en: Read each chapter in order in Learn. The sections follow the textbook and show its Textbook page numbers, so you can read along in the book. Each idea goes in small steps: what it is, an everyday analogy, the textbook definition, a breakdown, an example, common traps and a quick check. Each section has a badge: High-yield (often tested) or Must know (later sections build on it); these chapters have no Background sections. The badges are this site's own judgement from the textbook and the lectures, not an official test scope. When a section makes sense, press Mark as learned. The Exam focus list at the end of each chapter shows how it is most likely to be tested.

howToUse.zh: 「考试这样写 Exam English」方框里是能直接写上考卷的英文。教材定义要认得、会写：选择题常常让你在几个很像的定义里挑出对的那个（rods 和 cones、US 和 CS、负强化和惩罚……）。英文用教材的加拿大拼法：behaviour、colour。标着「补充 Extra」的内容是课外背景，考试以教材和讲课为准。
howToUse.en: The Exam English boxes hold English you can write on the test. Learn to recognize and write the textbook definitions: a multiple-choice question often asks you to pick the right one among very similar definitions (rods and cones, US and CS, negative reinforcement and punishment...). Use the textbook's Canadian spelling: behaviour, colour. Notes labelled Extra are background beyond the course; for the test, the textbook and the lectures come first.

howToUse.zh: 每章最后一节「讲课重点（简答题）」跟着讲课课件一页一页走（第 4 章第 20 节、第 5 章第 19 节、第 6 章第 20 节）。每个可能考简答的点都有一道「讨论题」，点「看参考答案」就能看到英文范文和中文的得分点。「注意 Caution」提醒框列出讲课和教材说法不同的地方：简答题按讲课写，选择题按教材选。比如讲课写 UCS、UCR，教材写 US、UR；讲课说四种基本味觉，教材加上 umami 一共五种。还要留意：讲课把注意（三个功能）和阈下知觉放在《Consciousness》里讲，教材却放在第 4 章。
howToUse.en: The last section of each chapter, Lecture review for short answers, walks through the lecture deck slide by slide (Chapter 4 section 20, Chapter 5 section 19, Chapter 6 section 20). Every point that could be a short answer has a discussion question; press Show model answer to see an English model answer with its scoring points explained in Chinese. The Caution notes list where the lecture and the textbook differ: write short answers the lecture's way and choose multiple-choice answers the textbook's way. For example, the lecture writes UCS and UCR where the textbook writes US and UR, and the lecture lists four basic tastes where the textbook adds umami as a fifth. Also note that the lecture teaches attention (with its three functions) and subliminal perception in the Consciousness deck, while the textbook teaches them in Chapter 4.

howToUse.zh: 讲义里有能动手的互动演示，别跳过：信号检测论（第 4 章第 4 节，拖动判断标准，看击中和虚报一起变）；负后像（第 4 章第 10 节，盯着旗子 20 秒再看白底）；睡眠周期图（第 5 章第 8 节）；经典条件反射模拟器（第 6 章：巴甫洛夫、小阿尔伯特、味觉厌恶）；强化程序（第 6 章第 13 节）；强化和惩罚的四象限练习（第 6 章第 14 节）；还有十几个分类练习（自下而上还是自上而下、视杆还是视锥、深度线索、听觉理论、意识层次、药物类别、学习类型……）。练到能先说出答案再点为止。
howToUse.en: The lessons have hands-on demos; do not skip them: signal detection (Chapter 4 section 4: drag the criterion and watch hits and false alarms change together), the afterimage (Chapter 4 section 10: stare at the flag for 20 seconds, then at the white field), the sleep-cycle chart (Chapter 5 section 8), the classical conditioning simulator (Chapter 6: Pavlov, Little Albert, taste aversion), reinforcement schedules (Chapter 6 section 13), the reinforcement and punishment quadrant drill (Chapter 6 section 14), and about a dozen sorting drills (bottom-up or top-down, rods or cones, depth cues, hearing theories, levels of awareness, drug classes, types of learning...). Practise until you can say the answer before you click.

howToUse.zh: 每学完一章，点章末的「练习这一课」，或者去「刷题 Practice」。题目和真实测验一样用英文出，选择题都是 4 个选项（和教材课后测验一样；大纲没写真实测验每题几个选项）；看不懂就点「显示中文」。每章大约 85 道题：先在「题型筛选」里点「只做客观题 Objective only」，练选择、判断和多选（第 4 章还有两道韦伯定律计算题）；再点「只做主观题 Written only」，练讲课的简答和论述题：先用英文写下答案，再点「对照参考答案自评」，勾出写到的得分点（写到一半就算对）。
howToUse.en: After each chapter, press Practice this lesson at the end, or go to Practice. Questions are in English like the real test, and the multiple-choice ones have 4 options, like the textbook's own quizzes (the syllabus does not say how many options the real test has); tap Show Chinese when you are stuck. Each chapter has about 85 questions. First press Objective only under Question types for multiple choice, true/false and select-all (Chapter 4 also has two Weber's law calculations); then press Written only for the lecture short and long answers: write your answer in English first, then press Compare and grade yourself and tick the scoring points you covered (half of them counts as correct).

howToUse.zh: 测验只用英文，术语一定要认得。「术语表」里有三章约 260 个术语的英文定义和中文解释；用「闪卡」来背：先练「英→中」（看到英文认得意思），再练「中→英」（自己想出英文），熟了以后勾选「只练不熟的卡」。最容易丢分的是长得像、意思却不同的词：rods 和 cones、place theory 和 frequency theory、nightmare 和 night terror、tolerance 和 dependence、negative reinforcement 和 punishment、latent learning 和 insight learning。
howToUse.en: The tests use English only, so you must recognize every term. The Glossary gives English definitions and Chinese explanations for about 260 terms; drill them with Flashcards: first EN to ZH (recognize the meaning), then ZH to EN (recall the English), then tick Only unfamiliar cards. Pairs that look alike but mean different things cost the most marks: rods and cones, place theory and frequency theory, nightmares and night terrors, tolerance and dependence, negative reinforcement and punishment, latent learning and insight learning.

howToUse.zh: 答错的题会自动进「错题本」，之后答对了就自动移出。每天花 10 分钟清一清：可以按章点「重练本单元」，也可以点「全部重练」。每道错题都问自己：是概念不会、两个词搞混了，还是英文题目没读懂？
howToUse.en: Wrong answers go to the mistake book automatically and leave once you answer them correctly. Spend 10 minutes a day clearing it, chapter by chapter with Retry unit or all at once with Retry all. For each wrong answer, ask yourself: did I not know the idea, mix up two terms, or misread the English?

howToUse.zh: 用「模拟考」检验自己：默认设置按大纲组卷——三章全选、30 道选择题加 3 道简答题、50 分钟。大纲没写简答题有几道，3 道只是练习用的估计，真实题量看 Quercus 公告。像真考一样限时作答，不点“显示中文”。交卷后选择题自动判分，简答题对照参考答案自评；成绩单按章告诉你哪里最弱。题目和「刷题」来自同一个题库，所以每道题都要重新想，不要凭记忆选。
howToUse.en: Test yourself with the Mock exam. Its default settings follow the syllabus: all three chapters, 30 multiple-choice questions plus 3 short answers, 50 minutes. The syllabus does not say how many short answers there are, so 3 is only a practice estimate; the Quercus announcements have the real number. Work under the time limit without Show Chinese. Multiple choice is graded when you hand in, you grade the short answers against the model answers, and the report shows your weakest chapter. The questions come from the same banks as Practice, so think every question through again instead of answering from memory.

howToUse.zh: 考前用「速记 Cheat sheet」：每章最该记的英文要点一页看完，还有几条值得单独记的规则（比如韦伯定律、“正＝加上、负＝拿走”、强化让行为变多、惩罚让行为变少、四种强化程序、睡眠阶段和脑电波）和「易混概念」，可以打印。「答题 Exam English」工具箱教你用英文写简答：题目指令词（define、describe、explain、compare……）、答题模板（下定义再举例、找出 US/UR/CS/CR、判断是哪种强化或惩罚……）、常见英文错误和 50 分钟的答题策略。
howToUse.en: Before a test, use the Cheat sheet: the key English points of each chapter on one page, a few rules worth a line of their own (such as Weber's law, positive = added and negative = removed, reinforcement increases and punishment decreases a behaviour, the four schedules, the sleep stages and their brain waves) and the Easily confused pairs; you can print it. The Exam English toolkit teaches you to write short answers in English: question verbs (define, describe, explain, compare...), answer templates (define a term and give an example, identify the US, UR, CS and CR, classify a consequence...), common English mistakes and a strategy for the 50 minutes.

howToUse.zh: 跟着「学习计划」走，做完一项打一个勾。进度只保存在这台设备的浏览器里，换电脑或清理浏览器之前，先到「设置」导出备份。「设置」里还能换语言模式：刚开始用「中文优先」，平时用「中英平衡」，考前几天换成「英文练习」（中文先模糊，逼自己先读英文）。考试时间、考场、简答题题量这些官方信息，永远以老师在 Quercus 上公布的为准。本站只用来复习：大纲规定，任何测验和作业都不能用生成式 AI 来完成。
howToUse.en: Follow a Study plan and tick each task when it is done. Progress is saved only in this browser on this device, so export a backup in Settings before you switch computers or clear the browser. Settings also has language modes: Chinese first when you start, Balanced for normal study, and English practice in the last days before a test (Chinese is blurred, so you read the English first). Official information such as the test time, the room and the number of short answers always comes from the instructor on Quercus. This site is for studying only: the syllabus says generative AI may not be used to complete any test or assignment.

intro.zh:
心理学是研究行为和心理过程的科学。测验 2 的三章正好顺着一条线走：信息从外面的世界进来，被我们觉察到，再改变我们的行为。
第 4 章：信息怎么进来。感受器把光、声波、压力、化学物质这些能量变成神经信号（感觉，**sensation**），大脑再把信号组织起来、解释出意义（知觉，**perception**）。
第 5 章：我们觉察到多少。意识（**consciousness**）＝觉察＋唤醒，有五个层次；睡眠和做梦每晚都会改变意识，药物、催眠和冥想也会。
第 6 章：经验怎样改变行为（学习，**learning**）：一个刺激反复出现（非联结学习）、两个刺激配对（经典条件反射）、行为和后果连在一起（操作性条件反射），或者看别人怎么做（观察学习）。
一杯咖啡就能把三章串起来：鼻子里的感受器闻到咖啡的分子，大脑认出“是咖啡”（第 4 章；嗅觉是唯一不经过丘脑的感觉）；咖啡因（**caffeine**）是兴奋剂，是世界上用得最多的精神活性药物，喝太多会睡不好（第 5 章）；喝了很多次以后，光是看到、闻到咖啡就会精神一振，这是经典条件反射（第 6 章）。讲课还补了一句：咖啡因本身引起的手抖是药物作用，不算学习。
三条主线下面，是第 3 章的大脑与神经系统（本站没有这一章），见下面“贯穿全课的主线”。
intro.en:
Psychology is the scientific study of behaviour and mental processes. The three chapters of Test 2 follow one path: information comes in from the world, we become aware of it, and it changes what we do.
Chapter 4: how information gets in. Receptors turn energy such as light, sound waves, pressure and chemicals into nerve signals (**sensation**), and the brain organizes and interprets those signals to give them meaning (**perception**).
Chapter 5: how much of it we are aware of. **Consciousness** is awareness plus arousal, and it has five levels; sleep and dreams change it every night, and drugs, hypnosis and meditation change it too.
Chapter 6: how experience changes behaviour (**learning**): one stimulus repeated (non-associative learning), two stimuli paired (classical conditioning), a behaviour linked to its consequences (operant conditioning), or watching what others do (observational learning).
One cup of coffee connects all three: receptors in your nose detect the coffee molecules and your brain recognizes 'coffee' (Chapter 4; smell is the one sense that skips the thalamus); **caffeine** is a stimulant, the world's most widely used psychoactive drug, and too much of it disturbs sleep (Chapter 5); after many cups, just seeing and smelling coffee can perk you up, which is classical conditioning (Chapter 6). The lecture adds that the jitters caused by caffeine itself are a drug effect, not learning.
Under the three branches lies Chapter 3, the brain and nervous system, which is not in this station; see the thread below.

summary.zh: 第 4 章先分清感觉（**sensation**，感受器接收能量并转成动作电位，这一步叫换能 **transduction**）和知觉（**perception**，大脑组织、解释这些信息），以及自下而上（**bottom-up processing**，从感受器开始）和自上而下（**top-down processing**，从已有的知识和预期开始）的加工。然后是测量感觉的工具：绝对阈限（**absolute threshold**）和差别阈限（**difference threshold**，JND）都按 50% 的察觉率来定义；韦伯定律（**Weber's law**）说两个刺激要差一个固定的比例才能被察觉（20 支蜡烛加 1 支，增加 5%）；信号检测论（**signal detection theory**）有击中、漏报、虚报、正确拒绝四种结果。再加上注意、知觉定势和感觉适应。接着逐个讲感觉：视觉（波长→色调、振幅→亮度、纯度→饱和度；视杆细胞 rods 管暗光，视锥细胞 cones 管颜色和细节；视交叉；Hubel 和 Wiesel 的特征检测器；三色说和拮抗过程说都对）、深度线索（双眼 vs 单眼）、听觉（频率→音高、振幅→响度；位置说解释高频声音，频率说解释每秒 1000 次以下的低频声音，齐射原理让一群神经元轮流放电、跟上更快的频率）、皮肤感觉和痛觉（快、慢两条通路，内啡肽）、味觉和嗅觉（教材五种基本味觉含 umami，讲课四种），以及动觉和前庭觉。做题先问：这一步是在“接收能量”（感觉）还是“解释意义”（知觉）？是哪种感觉、哪个结构？简答题看第 20 节：讲课对感觉和知觉的定义、韦伯的 JND 比例、视锥和视杆、两种颜色理论、耳朵的结构、味觉、嗅觉和痛觉。
summary.en: Chapter 4 starts by separating **sensation** (receptors take in energy and turn it into action potentials, a step called **transduction**) from **perception** (the brain organizes and interprets that information), and **bottom-up processing** (starting at the receptors) from **top-down processing** (starting from knowledge and expectations). Then come the tools for measuring the senses: the **absolute threshold** and the **difference threshold** (JND) are both defined at 50 percent detection; **Weber's law** says two stimuli must differ by a constant proportion to be noticed as different (add 1 candle to 20, a 5 percent increase); **signal detection theory** has four outcomes: hit, miss, false alarm and correct rejection. Attention, perceptual set and sensory adaptation follow. Then each sense in turn: vision (wavelength gives hue, amplitude brightness, purity saturation; rods for dim light, cones for colour and detail; the optic chiasm; Hubel and Wiesel's feature detectors; the trichromatic and opponent-process theories are both right), depth cues (binocular vs monocular), hearing (frequency gives pitch, amplitude loudness; place theory explains high frequencies and frequency theory low ones, below about 1,000 per second, while the volley principle lets groups of neurons take turns firing to follow faster sounds), the skin senses and pain (fast and slow pathways, endorphins), taste and smell (five basic tastes with umami in the textbook, four in the lecture), and the kinesthetic and vestibular senses. For any question, ask: is this step taking in energy (sensation) or giving it meaning (perception)? Which sense, which structure? For short answers, see section 20: the lecture's definitions of sensation and perception, Weber's JND fraction, rods and cones, the two colour theories, the parts of the ear, taste, smell and pain.

summary.zh: 意识（**consciousness**）有两部分：觉察（**awareness**，和前额叶皮层、全脑工作空间有关）和唤醒（**arousal**，靠网状激活系统）。William James 把心灵比作意识流；心理理论（**theory of mind**）是明白别人也有自己的想法。意识有五个层次：高层意识是控制加工（**controlled processes**），需要选择性注意；低层意识是自动加工（**automatic processes**）和白日梦；然后是意识改变状态、潜意识觉察（醒着时的酝酿、睡眠和梦）和无觉察（Freud 的无意识）。睡眠：视交叉上核（**SCN**）按视网膜传来的光暗信息校准昼夜节律，时差和轮班会打乱它。睡眠阶段：清醒是 β 波，放松是 α 波，然后 N1（θ 波）→ N2（睡眠纺锤波）→ N3（δ 波，最深的慢波睡眠）→ REM（快波，按 β 波记），一个周期约 90–100 分钟；N3 集中在前半夜，REM 越到早上越长。噩梦（**nightmare**）把人从 REM 中惊醒、常能记住；夜惊（**night terror**）发生在 N3、通常记不住。梦的理论：Freud（显性内容 vs 隐性内容）、认知理论、激活-整合理论、进化理论（威胁模拟）。药物：耐受性、生理依赖 vs 心理依赖、成瘾，奖赏通路（VTA、伏隔核、多巴胺）；抑制剂（酒精、巴比妥类、镇静剂、阿片类）、兴奋剂（咖啡因、尼古丁、安非他明、可卡因、MDMA）、致幻剂（大麻作用弱，LSD 作用强）。催眠：Hilgard 的分离意识观（隐藏的观察者）vs 社会认知行为观。冥想：正念冥想和慈心冥想。简答题看第 19 节：注意的三个功能、睡眠的四个功能、REM 的特点、五种梦的观点、清醒梦的方法。
summary.en: **Consciousness** has two parts: awareness (linked to the prefrontal cortex and a global brain workspace) and arousal (run by the reticular activating system). William James called the mind a stream of consciousness, and **theory of mind** is understanding that other people have their own thoughts. There are five levels of awareness: higher-level (**controlled processes**, which need selective attention), lower-level (**automatic processes** and daydreaming), altered states, subconscious awareness (incubation while awake, sleep and dreams) and no awareness (Freud's unconscious thought). Sleep: the suprachiasmatic nucleus (**SCN**) keeps circadian rhythms in step using light information from the retina, and jet lag and shift work throw it off. The stages: beta waves awake, alpha waves relaxed, then N1 (theta waves), N2 (sleep spindles), N3 (delta waves, the deepest, slow-wave sleep) and REM (fast waves; learn them as beta), in cycles of about 90 to 100 minutes; N3 comes mostly early in the night and REM periods grow longer toward morning. A **nightmare** wakes us from REM and is often remembered; a **night terror** happens in N3 and usually is not. Dream theories: Freud (manifest vs latent content), cognitive, activation-synthesis and evolutionary (threat simulation). Drugs: tolerance, physical vs psychological dependence, addiction, and the reward pathway (VTA, nucleus accumbens, dopamine); depressants (alcohol, barbiturates, tranquilizers, opiates), stimulants (caffeine, nicotine, amphetamines, cocaine, MDMA) and hallucinogens (marijuana mild, LSD strong). Hypnosis: Hilgard's divided consciousness view (the hidden observer) vs the social cognitive behaviour view. Meditation: mindfulness and lovingkindness. For short answers, see section 19: the three functions of attention, the four functions of sleep, the features of REM sleep, the five views of dreaming and the lucid-dreaming techniques.

summary.zh: 学习（**learning**）：教材定义是来自认知经历的、有规律的、相对持久的行为改变；讲课定义是基于经验的、持久的反应方式改变，药物作用、疲劳和生病都不算。非联结学习：习惯化（**habituation**，反应变小）、敏感化（**sensitization**，反应变大）、印刻（**imprinting**）。经典条件反射（**classical conditioning**，Pavlov）：中性刺激和 US 配对，US 自动引出 UR；配对以后，中性刺激变成 CS，单独就能引出 CR（讲课写 UCS、UCR）。接着是习得（接近性 **contiguity** 和相倚性 **contingency**）、泛化、辨别、消退、自发恢复、更新，以及应用：小阿尔伯特、对抗条件作用、厌恶条件作用、安慰剂、免疫系统、味觉厌恶、广告、药物习惯化。操作性条件反射（**operant conditioning**）：Thorndike 的效果律、Skinner 箱、塑造；“正”＝加上一个刺激，“负”＝拿走一个刺激；强化让行为变多，惩罚让行为变少，所以负强化不是惩罚；回避学习、习得性无助；初级 vs 次级强化物；FR、VR、FI、VI 四种强化程序（VR 最难消退）。观察学习：Bandura 的 Bobo 玩偶实验和四个过程（注意、保持、动作再现、强化）。认知因素：Tolman 的潜伏学习、Köhler 的顿悟学习。生物限制：本能漂移（Breland 夫妇）vs 准备性（Garcia）。还有文化、固定型 vs 成长型心态（Dweck），以及压力与可预测性、控制感。做情境题先数：一个刺激反复出现 → 非联结学习；两个刺激配对 → 经典条件反射；行为带来后果 → 操作性条件反射；看别人 → 观察学习。操作性再问两步：加上还是拿走？行为变多还是变少？简答题看第 20 节。
summary.en: **Learning**: the textbook defines it as a systematic, relatively permanent change in behaviour that comes from cognitive experience; the lecture defines it as an enduring change in the way an organism responds based on experience, and drug effects, fatigue and illness do not count. Non-associative learning: **habituation** (the response shrinks), **sensitization** (the response grows) and **imprinting**. **Classical conditioning** (Pavlov): a neutral stimulus is paired with a US that automatically produces a UR; after pairing, the neutral stimulus has become a CS that produces a CR by itself (the lecture writes UCS and UCR). Then come acquisition (**contiguity** and **contingency**), generalization, discrimination, extinction, spontaneous recovery and renewal, and the applications: Little Albert, counterconditioning, aversive conditioning, placebos, the immune system, taste aversion, advertising and drug habituation. **Operant conditioning**: Thorndike's law of effect, the Skinner box and shaping; positive means a stimulus is added and negative means one is removed; reinforcement makes a behaviour more likely and punishment less likely, so negative reinforcement is not punishment; avoidance learning and learned helplessness; primary vs secondary reinforcers; the FR, VR, FI and VI schedules (VR resists extinction best). Observational learning: Bandura's Bobo doll study and its four processes (attention, retention, motor reproduction, reinforcement). Cognitive factors: Tolman's latent learning and Köhler's insight learning. Biological limits: instinctive drift (the Brelands) vs preparedness (Garcia). Then culture, fixed vs growth mindset (Dweck), and stress with predictability and control. For a scenario, count first: one repeated stimulus means non-associative learning; two stimuli paired, classical conditioning; a behaviour and its consequence, operant conditioning; watching someone, observational learning. For operant conditioning, ask two more questions: added or removed? More or less likely? For short answers, see section 20.

title.zh: 贯穿三章：大脑与神经系统（第 3 章）
title.en: Throughout: the brain and nervous system (Chapter 3)

summary.zh:
第 3 章（大脑与神经系统）在这三章之前，本站没有收录，但三章处处都用到它。遇到新的身体结构，讲义第一次出现时都会解释，也可以查术语表。
第 4 章：感受器把能量变成动作电位（换能）。神经元遵循全或无原则（**all-or-nothing principle**），所以刺激越强，神经元放电越频繁，而不是每次放电更强。几乎所有感觉都先经过丘脑（**thalamus**，大脑的中转站；嗅觉例外），再到大脑皮层各自的区域：视觉在枕叶，听觉在颞叶，触觉、温度和痛觉在顶叶。在视交叉，左视野的信息交叉到右半球，第 3 章的裂脑研究用的正是这种交叉。快痛走有髓鞘的纤维，慢痛走无髓鞘的纤维（髓鞘让神经传导更快）。
第 5 章：觉察和前额叶皮层、全脑工作空间有关；唤醒靠网状激活系统（脑干、延髓、丘脑），网状结构受损可能导致昏迷。视交叉上核（**SCN**）是下丘脑里的一个小结构，按视网膜传来的光暗信息校准昼夜节律。从 N1 到 N3，血清素、去甲肾上腺素和乙酰胆碱越来越少，乙酰胆碱上升开启 REM 睡眠。药物都作用在突触上：酒精增加 GABA（大脑的“刹车”）；尼古丁、安非他明、可卡因等兴奋剂增强多巴胺的作用；阿片类作用在用内啡肽的突触上；LSD 主要作用于血清素；成瘾药物都会提高奖赏通路（腹侧被盖区 VTA 和伏隔核）里的多巴胺。
第 6 章：经典条件反射能改变免疫系统和内分泌（激素）系统，交感神经系统也参与其中；研究者把人和猴子“准备好”的怕蛇和杏仁核（**amygdala**，边缘系统里和情绪有关的部分）联系起来；压力是身体对环境中威胁的反应（第 3 章）。
summary.en:
Chapter 3, the brain and nervous system, comes before these chapters and is not in this station, but all three chapters lean on it. When a body part is new, the lesson explains it the first time it appears, and the Glossary has it too.
Chapter 4: receptors turn energy into action potentials (transduction). Neurons follow the **all-or-nothing principle**, so a stronger stimulus makes them fire more often, not more strongly. Nearly every sense passes through the **thalamus**, the brain's relay station (smell is the exception), before reaching its own cortex area: vision in the occipital lobes, hearing in the temporal lobes, and touch, temperature and pain in the parietal lobes. At the optic chiasm, information from the left visual field crosses to the right hemisphere, the same crossing the Chapter 3 split-brain studies rely on. Fast pain travels on myelinated fibres and slow pain on unmyelinated ones (myelin speeds up conduction).
Chapter 5: awareness involves the prefrontal cortex and a global brain workspace, and arousal depends on the reticular activating system (brain stem, medulla, thalamus); damage to the reticular formation can cause coma. The suprachiasmatic nucleus (**SCN**), a small structure in the hypothalamus, uses light information from the retina to keep circadian rhythms on time. Serotonin, norepinephrine and acetylcholine fall from N1 to N3, and a rise in acetylcholine starts REM sleep. Drugs act at synapses: alcohol increases GABA (the brain's brake pedal); stimulants such as nicotine, amphetamines and cocaine increase dopamine's effects; opiates act at the synapses that use endorphins; LSD acts mainly on serotonin; and addictive drugs raise dopamine in the reward pathway (the VTA and the nucleus accumbens).
Chapter 6: classical conditioning can change the immune and endocrine (hormone) systems, with the sympathetic nervous system involved; researchers link the prepared fear of snakes in humans and monkeys to the **amygdala**, the part of the limbic system involved in emotion; and stress is the body's response to a threat in the environment (Chapter 3).

why.zh: 第 4 章讲注意（**attention**）：把觉察集中在环境中的一小部分；选择性注意（**selective attention**）是专注一部分、忽略其余部分，例子有 Stroop 效应和非注意盲视。第 5 章接着用：意识最清醒的一层是控制加工（**controlled processes**），它需要选择性注意，而且更多用到前额叶皮层；同一件事练熟以后，就变成不太需要注意的自动加工（**automatic processes**）。讲课把注意放进了《Consciousness》课件：注意是集中觉察的过程，有三个功能（朝向环境、控制意识的内容、保持警觉），做 Stroop 任务时背外侧前额叶皮层被激活。所以注意要学两遍：选择题按第 4 章，简答题按第 5 章第 19 节。
why.en: Chapter 4 teaches **attention**, focusing awareness on a narrow part of the environment, and **selective attention**, focusing on one part while ignoring the rest, with the Stroop effect and inattentional blindness as examples. Chapter 5 builds on it: the most alert level of awareness, **controlled processes**, needs selective attention and tends to involve the prefrontal cortex, and an activity practised a lot becomes an **automatic process** that needs little attention. The lecture moves attention into the Consciousness deck: attention is the process by which we focus awareness, it has three functions (orienting toward the environment, controlling the content of consciousness, maintaining alertness), and the Stroop task activates the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex. So learn attention twice: Chapter 4 for multiple choice, Chapter 5 section 19 for short answers.

why.zh: 阈下知觉（**subliminal perception**，第 4 章）是察觉到低于意识觉察水平的信息。教材的研究：口渴的被试在电脑上看到闪现 16 毫秒、谁都说没看见的“口渴”类词语，之后喝得更多（Strahan 等人）；教材也提醒，这类效果通常很弱，Vicary 的“吃爆米花”广告是一场骗局。第 5 章把它当作证据：很多心理过程可以在意识之外进行，并把它们放进意识的层次：醒着时的潜意识觉察（比如酝酿 **incubation**）、睡眠和梦，以及无觉察（Freud 的无意识）。第 5 章还说，意识有深浅之分，就像信号检测论（**signal detection theory**）里察觉也有深浅。讲课在《Consciousness》里讲阈下知觉，用的是 Eagle（1959）的图片研究：先看攻击性图片的人，对一个中性男孩的评价更负面。
why.en: **Subliminal perception** (Chapter 4) is detecting information below the level of conscious awareness. In the textbook's study, thirsty participants who saw thirst words flashed for 16 milliseconds, too fast for anyone to report seeing them, drank more afterwards (Strahan and colleagues); the textbook also warns that such effects are usually weak, and Vicary's 'eat popcorn' claim was a hoax. Chapter 5 uses this as evidence that many mental processes run outside awareness and places them on its levels of awareness: subconscious awareness while awake (such as **incubation**), sleep and dreams, and no awareness (Freud's unconscious). Chapter 5 even compares these shades of awareness to the shades of detection in **signal detection theory**. The lecture teaches subliminal perception in the Consciousness deck with Eagle's (1959) picture study: people who first saw an aggressive picture rated a neutral boy more negatively.

why.zh: 第 4 章说，知觉（**perception**）是大脑把信号组织起来、解释出意义，而且常常自上而下，用已有的知识去补全。第 5 章的激活-整合理论（**activation-synthesis theory**）说，梦就是大脑皮层在睡眠中干同样的活：把脑干等低层脑区发出的随机信号“编”成一个故事。醒着时，经验主要由外界刺激驱动；做梦时，主要由脑内自己产生的信号驱动。最生动的梦出现在 REM 睡眠（**REM sleep**），这时乙酰胆碱上升、大脑皮层被激活，脑电像清醒时一样（按 β 波记）。外面的声音有时也会混进来：闹钟或警笛声会变成梦的一部分。讲课把这叫作梦的生物学观点：皮层试图解释睡眠中大脑的随机神经放电。
why.en: In Chapter 4, **perception** is the brain organizing and interpreting signals to give them meaning, often from the top down, filling gaps with what it already knows. Chapter 5's **activation-synthesis theory** says a dream is the cortex doing the same job during sleep: it turns random signals from lower parts of the brain, such as the brain stem, into a story. Awake, experience is driven mostly by outside stimuli; in dreams, mostly by signals made inside the brain. The most vivid dreams come in **REM sleep**, when a rise in acetylcholine activates the cortex and the EEG looks like wakefulness (learn it as beta waves). Outside sounds can still slip in: an alarm or a siren can become part of a dream. The lecture calls this the biological view of dreaming: the cortex trying to interpret the random neural firing of the sleeping brain.

why.zh: 第 4 章的痛觉（**pain**）一节说，疼不疼、有多疼，大脑说了很多算：内啡肽（**endorphins**）是身体自己的“天然阿片”（第 3 章学过的神经递质），主要在慢通路的突触里把痛觉信号调小；动机、预期、文化和情绪也会改变痛觉。讲课列出的影响因素是：文化信念、情绪状态、外来药物（阿片类）和体内的递质（内啡肽）。第 5 章接上药物这一面：阿片类（**opiates**，如吗啡、海洛因）属于抑制剂，作用在用内啡肽传递信号的突触上，所以能止痛；药物离开大脑后，这些突触刺激不足，用药的人会渴求药物、出现痛苦的戒断。催眠也能减痛：一项脑成像研究里，被催眠的人脑干和中脑照样对电击有反应，感觉皮层却没有被激活，他们在某个层面感受到了疼，却始终没有意识到它，正好对应第 4 章“感觉”和“知觉”的区别。
why.en: Chapter 4's section on **pain** shows that the brain has a big say in how much something hurts: **endorphins**, the body's natural opiates (a Chapter 3 neurotransmitter), turn pain signals down, mainly in the synapses of the slow pathway, and motivation, expectation, culture and emotion change pain too. The lecture lists the influences on pain as cultural beliefs, emotional states, outside drugs (opiates) and internal transmitters (endorphins). Chapter 5 adds the drug side: **opiates** such as morphine and heroin are depressants that act at the synapses that use endorphins, which is why they relieve pain; when the drug leaves the brain, those synapses are understimulated, and users feel craving and painful withdrawal. Hypnosis can reduce pain too: in one brain-imaging study, the brain stem and midbrain of hypnotized people still responded to painful shocks, but their sensory cortex did not, so they sensed the pain on some level without ever becoming aware of it, a clear echo of the Chapter 4 split between sensation and perception.

why.zh: 两章都讲“一个东西一直在，后来就感觉不到了”，教材连例子都一样（衣服贴着皮肤），所以要靠定义来分。感觉适应（**sensory adaptation**，第 4 章）是感觉系统的反应性随着平均刺激水平而改变，而且是双向的：刚关灯看不见、慢慢看清；从暗处走到大太阳下先刺眼、慢慢正常；跳进冷水，很快就适应了。习惯化（**habituation**，第 6 章）是一种非联结学习：对反复出现或持续存在的刺激，反应随时间减少，比如再也听不见室友的钟表声；反过来，敏感化（**sensitization**）是反应变大，强刺激更容易引起。判断方法：题目讲感官在调整（明暗、冷热）→ 感觉适应；讲学会忽略一个反复出现的刺激，或者讲研究者反复给婴儿看同一个东西、直到宝宝不再反应 → 习惯化。
why.en: Both chapters describe no longer noticing something that stays around, and the textbook even uses the same example (clothes touching your skin), so the definitions decide. **Sensory adaptation** (Chapter 4) is a change in the responsiveness of a sensory system to the average level of stimulation, and it works both ways: in a dark room you slowly start to see, stepping into bright sun is dazzling at first, and a cold pool soon feels fine. **Habituation** (Chapter 6) is a form of non-associative learning: a decreasing response to a repeated or prolonged stimulus, such as no longer hearing a roommate's clock; its opposite, **sensitization**, is a growing response, more likely with intense stimuli. Clues: the senses adjusting (dark and light, cold and warm) point to sensory adaptation; learning to ignore a repeated stimulus, or researchers repeating a stimulus until a baby stops responding, points to habituation.

why.zh: 第 4 章讲我们怎样尝到味道：味蕾（**taste buds**）长在舌头的乳头（**papillae**）里；教材说有五种基本味觉（甜、酸、苦、咸和 umami），讲课只列四种；没有了气味，最爱吃的东西也会变得“没味道”。第 6 章讲学习怎样改变我们对味道的反应。味觉厌恶（**taste aversion**）：一种味道（CS）之后出了让人生病的事（US），引起恶心（UR）；以后光是这种味道就让人恶心（CR），而且常常一次就学会。从 Garcia 开始的味觉厌恶研究揭示了准备性（**preparedness**）：老鼠靠味觉和嗅觉挑食物、视力又差，所以容易把生病和味道连起来；鸟靠眼睛挑食物，就容易把生病和颜色连起来。一个物种依赖哪种感觉（第 4 章），决定了它更容易学会什么（第 6 章）。
why.en: Chapter 4 explains how we taste: **taste buds** sit in the **papillae** of the tongue; the textbook counts five basic tastes (sweet, sour, bitter, salty and umami) while the lecture lists four; and without their smell, favourite foods seem tasteless. Chapter 6 shows how learning changes our response to tastes. In **taste aversion**, a taste (CS) followed by something that makes us sick (US) produces nausea (UR), and afterwards the taste alone produces nausea (CR), often after a single pairing. Taste aversion research, starting with Garcia's, revealed **preparedness**: rats choose food by taste and smell and see poorly, so they link illness to tastes, while birds choose food by sight and link illness to colours. The senses a species relies on (Chapter 4) shape what it is ready to learn (Chapter 6).

why.zh: 第 4 章说，痛觉不只是皮肤传来的信号：大脑参与制造疼的感受，内啡肽能把它调小，预期和动机对痛觉的影响特别大，文化和情绪也会改变痛觉。第 6 章解释了“预期变成止痛效果”的一条路：安慰剂效应（**placebo effect**）可以用经典条件反射来理解。真正的止痛药（US）一次次带来止痛（UR）以后，光是药片或注射器（CS）就能让疼痛减轻（CR）。最有力的证据来自免疫和内分泌系统的条件作用：Ader 让老鼠喝糖水，同时配上一种会引起恶心、也会抑制免疫的药（Cytoxan）；后来光喝糖水，免疫系统就被抑制了。
why.en: Chapter 4 says pain is not just a signal from the skin: the brain helps create the experience, endorphins can turn it down, expectation and motivation affect pain especially strongly, and culture and emotion change it too. Chapter 6 explains one route from expectation to relief: the **placebo effect** through classical conditioning. After a real painkiller (US) has brought relief (UR) again and again, the pill or syringe (CS) alone can lower pain (CR). The strongest evidence comes from conditioning of the immune and endocrine systems: Ader gave rats sweetened water paired with a drug (Cytoxan) that causes nausea and also suppresses the immune system, and later the sweet water alone suppressed their immune systems.

why.zh: 第 5 章定义耐受性（**tolerance**）：要用更多的药，才能得到同样的效果。第 6 章用经典条件反射解释其中一部分，叫药物习惯化（**drug habituation**）：药物是 US，它对身体的作用是 UR；药片或注射器的样子、平时用药的房间变成 CS。特别之处：这里的 CR 和 UR 方向相反，身体提前“防备”药物（比如药让心跳加快，CR 就是心跳先变慢），所以同样的剂量效果变弱了。这也能解释一些过量死亡：在一个新地方用药，没有熟悉的 CS，身体没有提前准备，平常的剂量作用就会强得多。别和第 6 章第 2 节的习惯化（只有一个刺激的非联结学习）搞混。讲课把这几个角色写成 UCS、UCR、CS、CR。
why.en: Chapter 5 defines **tolerance**: needing more of a drug to get the same effect. Chapter 6 explains part of it with classical conditioning, called **drug habituation**. The drug is the US and its effect on the body is the UR; the look of the pill or syringe and the room where the drug is usually taken become CSs. The twist is that the CR is the opposite of the UR: the body braces itself for the drug (if the drug raises heart rate, the CR is a drop in heart rate), so the same dose has less effect. This also explains some overdoses: in a new place there is no familiar CS, the body does not prepare, and the usual dose hits much harder. Do not confuse it with habituation in Chapter 6 section 2, non-associative learning with a single stimulus. The lecture writes these roles as UCS, UCR, CS and CR.

why.zh: 咖啡因（**caffeine**）是第 5 章的兴奋剂（**stimulant**），也是世界上用得最多的精神活性药物；喝太多会焦虑、睡不好。第 6 章正是用咖啡开头的，因为它就是身边的经典条件反射：喝过很多次以后，咖啡的样子和香味（CS）预示着咖啡因带来的精神，于是光是看到、闻到就能让人一振（CR），咖啡喝得越多的人反应越强。讲课画了一条线：咖啡因本身引起的手抖是药物作用，不算学习，因为学习是基于经验的、持久的反应改变。而排队买咖啡、还没喝就已经精神起来，这才是学来的。
why.en: **Caffeine** is a Chapter 5 **stimulant** and the world's most widely used psychoactive drug; too much of it brings anxiety and poor sleep. Chapter 6 opens with coffee because it is everyday classical conditioning: after many cups, the sight and smell of coffee (CS) predict the caffeine boost, so they alone can perk you up (CR), and heavier coffee drinkers respond most strongly. The lecture draws the line: jitters caused by the caffeine itself are a drug effect, not learning, because learning is an enduring change in responding that comes from experience. Feeling more awake while you queue for coffee, before you drink any, is learned.

why.zh: 两章最后都在讲怎样对付压力。第 5 章说冥想（**meditation**）是一种工具：正念冥想帮 Melissa Munroe 承受癌症带来的剧痛，冥想能减轻压力和焦虑，参加八周冥想训练的人打流感疫苗后免疫反应更好。第 6 章用动物学习研究回答同一个问题：坏事可以预测、自己有一定的控制、感觉情况在改善、有发泄的渠道，压力就小；无法控制的坏事会导致习得性无助（**learned helplessness**）。两章都碰到免疫系统：冥想帮了它，无法控制的噪音削弱了它，经典条件反射还能抑制它（第 6 章）。讲课补充：冥想时脑电出现 α 波，也就是放松而清醒的状态。
why.en: Both chapters end with ways to handle stress. Chapter 5 presents **meditation** as a tool: mindfulness helped Melissa Munroe cope with severe cancer pain, meditation reduces stress and anxiety, and people in an eight-week meditation program showed a better immune response to a flu vaccine. Chapter 6 answers the same question with animal learning studies: stress is lower when bad events are predictable, when we have some control, when things seem to be improving and when we have an outlet for frustration, while uncontrollable bad events can lead to **learned helplessness**. Both chapters meet the immune system: meditation helped it, uncontrollable noise weakened it, and classical conditioning can suppress it (Chapter 6). The lecture adds that meditation shows alpha waves, the EEG of a relaxed but awake brain.

title.zh: 测验 2 冲刺计划（11 月 16 日 周一）

note.zh:
这个计划给 LEC0101 和 LEC0102：测验 2 在 11 月 16 日周一，就在平时的讲课时间里考（LEC0101 上午 11 点到下午 1 点，LEC0102 下午 1 点到 3 点），50 分钟，考第 4、5、6 章：30 道教材选择题，加上讲课内容的简答题（LEC0103 已在 11 月 3 日考过）。大纲没写简答题有几道，也没写选择题每题几个选项，请看 Quercus 上的公告；本站的模拟考暂按 3 道简答、每题 4 个选项来练。具体开考时间、考场和要带什么，也以 Quercus 为准。测验 2 不考实验课的内容（大纲把实验测试放在测验 3 和测验 6），所以第 4 次实验（Sensation and Perception）不用为测验 2 复习。
计划按优先级排：每天先读「高频考点」小节和讲课重点小节，再读「必会」小节（这三章没有「了解」小节）。周一有讲课，那一周你可能还有别的考试，所以第 2、3 天只安排约 2 小时；其他日子约 4–5 小时。落后了怎么办：「高频考点」小节、三章的讲课重点和两次模拟考都别跳；「必会」小节可以只看「考试这样写」、易错点和小测验；某一章刷题正确率已经很高，就改成只做「随机」20 题。最后，别熬夜：第 5 章说睡眠帮助巩固记忆，成年人最好睡 7–9 小时。
note.en:
This plan is for LEC0101 and LEC0102: Test 2 is on Monday Nov 16 during your regular lecture time (LEC0101 11 am to 1 pm, LEC0102 1 pm to 3 pm). It lasts 50 minutes and covers Chapters 4, 5 and 6: 30 multiple-choice questions on the textbook plus short-answer questions on the lectures (LEC0103 wrote it on Nov 3). The syllabus does not say how many short-answer questions there are or how many options each multiple-choice question has, so check the Quercus announcements; the station's mock test uses 3 short answers and 4 options for practice. The exact start time, the room and what to bring are on Quercus too. Lab material is not on Test 2 (the syllabus puts the lab tests on Tests 3 and 6), so you do not need to review Lab 4 (Sensation and Perception) for Test 2.
The plan goes by priority: each day, read the High-yield sections and the lecture-review sections first, then the Must know sections (these chapters have no Background sections). Days 2 and 3 have only about 2 hours, because Monday has the lecture and you may have other tests that week; the other days take about 4-5 hours. If you fall behind, keep every High-yield section, the three lecture-review sections and both mock tests; for Must know sections, read only the Exam English boxes, the traps and the quick checks; and for a chapter where your practice score is already high, do only Random (20 questions). Finally, do not pull an all-nighter: Chapter 5 says sleep helps consolidate memories, and adults do best with 7-9 hours.

label.zh: 第 1 天（11月8日 周日）：确认信息 + 第 4 章前半（第 1–12 节）
label.en: Day 1 (Sun Nov 8): check Quercus, Chapter 4 sections 1-12

tasks.zh: 上 Quercus 找测验 2 的公告（15 分钟）：抄下你那个班的开考时间和考场、要带什么、简答题有几道、长什么样；有关于考试范围的细节也一起记下来。
tasks.en: Find the Test 2 announcement on Quercus (15 minutes) and copy down your section's start time and room, what to bring, and how many short-answer questions there are and what they look like; note any detail about the coverage too.

tasks.zh: 读首页的「新手指南」和「知识地图」（15 分钟），到「设置」选语言模式：英文还很吃力就选「中文优先」。然后打开第 4 章，看看每节的「高频考点」和「必会」标签。
tasks.en: Read the guide and The big picture on the home page (15 minutes), then choose a language mode in Settings: Chinese first if English is still hard. Then open Chapter 4 and look at the High-yield and Must know badges of its sections.

tasks.zh: 第 4 章第 1–6 节（约 1.5 小时，其中第 1、3、4、5 节是「高频考点」）：感觉 vs 知觉，自下而上 vs 自上而下（做分类练习）；感受器和换能；绝对阈限 vs 差别阈限，韦伯定律和蜡烛的例子（20 支加 1 支＝5%）；阈下知觉和口渴词研究；信号检测论（在演示里拖动判断标准，看击中和虚报一起变）；注意、Stroop 效应、非注意盲视、知觉定势；感觉适应。
tasks.en: Chapter 4 sections 1-6 (about 1.5 hours; sections 1, 3, 4 and 5 are High-yield): sensation vs perception and bottom-up vs top-down (do the sorting drill); receptors and transduction; absolute vs difference threshold and Weber's law with the candles (1 added to 20 is 5 percent); subliminal perception and the thirst-word study; signal detection (drag the criterion in the demo and watch hits and false alarms move together); attention, the Stroop effect, inattentional blindness and perceptual set; sensory adaptation.

tasks.zh: 第 4 章第 7–12 节（约 1.5 小时，其中第 8、10、11 节是「高频考点」）：光的三个特征（波长→色调、振幅→亮度、纯度→饱和度）；眼睛的结构，视杆 vs 视锥（分类练习），中央凹和盲点；视交叉、特征检测器、“什么”和“哪里”通路；三色说 vs 拮抗过程说（做负后像演示：盯旗子 20 秒再看白底，用拮抗过程说解释看到的颜色）；图形-背景、格式塔原则、双眼 vs 单眼深度线索（分类练习）；运动知觉和知觉恒常性。
tasks.en: Chapter 4 sections 7-12 (about 1.5 hours; sections 8, 10 and 11 are High-yield): the three features of light (wavelength gives hue, amplitude brightness, purity saturation); the parts of the eye, rods vs cones (sorting drill), the fovea and the blind spot; the optic chiasm, feature detectors and the 'what' and 'where' pathways; trichromatic vs opponent-process theory (do the afterimage demo: stare at the flag for 20 seconds, look at the white field, then explain the colours with opponent-process theory); figure-ground, the Gestalt principles and binocular vs monocular depth cues (sorting drill); motion perception and perceptual constancy.

tasks.zh: 「闪卡」15 分钟：选第 4 章、方向「英→中」，把今天见过的术语过一遍。
tasks.en: Flashcards, 15 minutes: Chapter 4, EN to ZH, to review the terms you met today.

label.zh: 第 2 天（11月9日 周一）：第 6 章讲课日（约 2 小时 + 讲课）
label.en: Day 2 (Mon Nov 9): Chapter 6 lecture day (about 2 hours plus the lecture)

tasks.zh: 讲课前（约 1 小时）：预习第 6 章第 1–4 节（第 3、4 节是「高频考点」）：学习的定义；习惯化、敏感化、印刻；几种学习类型（分类练习）；巴甫洛夫的 US、UR、中性刺激、CS、CR（用经典条件反射模拟器走一遍）。先认得这些词，英文讲课就容易听懂得多。
tasks.en: Before your lecture (about 1 hour): preview Chapter 6 sections 1-4 (sections 3 and 4 are High-yield): the definition of learning; habituation, sensitization and imprinting; the types of learning (sorting drill); Pavlov's US, UR, neutral stimulus, CS and CR (step through the classical conditioning simulator). Knowing these words first makes the English lecture much easier to follow.

tasks.zh: 去上第 6 章《Learning》的讲课（LEC0101 上午 11 点，LEC0102 下午 1 点）。记下老师特别强调的地方、课件上没有的例子，以及关于测验 2 的任何说明。
tasks.en: Attend the Chapter 6 lecture, Learning (LEC0101 at 11 am, LEC0102 at 1 pm). Note what the instructor stresses, any example that is not on the slides, and anything said about Test 2.

tasks.zh: 讲完趁热（约 45 分钟）：读第 6 章最后一节「讲课重点（简答题）」，和自己的笔记对一对；看清「注意」提醒框里讲课和教材的差别（讲课写 UCS、UCR，教材写 US、UR；两种学习的定义）。把课上新听到的内容补进笔记。
tasks.en: Right after the lecture (about 45 minutes): read the last section of Chapter 6, Lecture review for short answers, and compare it with your notes; study the Caution notes on lecture-textbook differences (UCS and UCR in the lecture, US and UR in the textbook; the two definitions of learning). Add anything new from class to your notes.

tasks.zh: 「闪卡」15 分钟：第 4 章，方向「英→中」，勾选「只练不熟的卡」。
tasks.en: Flashcards, 15 minutes: Chapter 4, EN to ZH, with Only unfamiliar cards.

label.zh: 第 3 天（11月10日 周二）：第 4 章后半（第 13–20 节，约 2 小时）

tasks.zh: 第 4 章第 13–19 节（约 1.25 小时，第 14 节是「高频考点」）：声波（频率→音高、振幅→响度、复杂度→音色）和外耳、中耳、内耳；位置说 vs 频率说和齐射原理（分类练习），声音定位；触觉和温度觉；痛觉的快、慢通路和内啡肽；乳头、味蕾、第五种味觉 umami，嗅觉不经过丘脑；动觉和前庭觉（半规管）；保护感官。
tasks.en: Chapter 4 sections 13-19 (about 1.25 hours; section 14 is High-yield): sound waves (frequency gives pitch, amplitude loudness, complexity timbre) and the outer, middle and inner ear; place theory vs frequency theory and the volley principle (sorting drill) and locating sounds; touch and temperature; the fast and slow pain pathways and endorphins; papillae, taste buds, umami as the fifth taste, and smell skipping the thalamus; the kinesthetic and vestibular senses (semicircular canals); keeping the senses healthy.

tasks.zh: 第 4 章第 20 节「讲课重点（简答题）」（约 45 分钟）：一页一页对着讲课走，背熟讲课对感觉和知觉的定义；看清讲课和教材的差别（讲课四种基本味觉，教材加上 umami 共五种；讲课的 Young-Helmholtz 理论就是教材的三色说）。每段英文范文大声读一遍。
tasks.en: Chapter 4 section 20, Lecture review for short answers (about 45 minutes): go through it slide by slide and learn the lecture's definitions of sensation and perception; note the differences (four basic tastes in the lecture, five with umami in the textbook; the lecture's Young-Helmholtz theory is the textbook's trichromatic theory). Read each English model answer aloud once.

label.zh: 第 4 天（11月11日 周三）：第 4 章刷题 + 第 5 章前段（第 1–6 节）
label.en: Day 4 (Wed Nov 11): Chapter 4 practice, Chapter 5 sections 1-6

tasks.zh: 第 4 章刷题（约 2 小时）：在「刷题」里点「只做客观题」，再点第 4 章卡片上的「按课练习」，大约 73 道题全部做完；每道题的解析都读，包括蒙对的题，解析里不认识的词去术语表查。做完到错题本里把第 4 章的错题重做到清空。
tasks.en: Chapter 4 practice (about 2 hours): in Practice, press Objective only, then Practice on the Chapter 4 card, and do all of its roughly 73 questions; read every explanation, including for questions you guessed right, and look up unknown words in the Glossary. Then retry the Chapter 4 questions in the mistake book until they are gone.

tasks.zh: 第 4 章简答题（约 45 分钟）：在「刷题」里点「只做主观题」，做第 4 章大约 11 道讲课简答和论述题：先用英文写，再点「对照参考答案自评」，勾出写到的得分点。写法记牢：术语 + 讲课定义 + 一个例子。
tasks.en: Chapter 4 written answers (about 45 minutes): in Practice, press Written only and do the roughly 11 lecture short and long answers of Chapter 4: write your English answer first, then press Compare and grade yourself and tick the points you covered. Remember the recipe: term + lecture definition + one example.

tasks.zh: 第 5 章第 1–6 节（约 1.25 小时，其中第 1、3、5 节是「高频考点」）：意识＝觉察＋唤醒，意识流，心理理论；意识和大脑（全脑工作空间、前额叶皮层、网状激活系统）；控制加工 vs 自动加工；意识的五个层次（分类练习）、酝酿、无意识；昼夜节律、视交叉上核（SCN）和视网膜、时差和轮班；为什么要睡觉、缺觉的后果。
tasks.en: Chapter 5 sections 1-6 (about 1.25 hours; sections 1, 3 and 5 are High-yield): consciousness as awareness plus arousal, the stream of consciousness and theory of mind; consciousness and the brain (global workspace, prefrontal cortex, reticular activating system); controlled vs automatic processes; the five levels of awareness (sorting drill), incubation and the unconscious; circadian rhythms, the SCN and the retina, jet lag and shift work; why we sleep and what sleep loss does.

label.zh: 第 5 天（11月12日 周四）：第 5 章后段（第 7–19 节）

tasks.zh: 第 5 章第 7–12 节，睡眠和梦（约 1.5 小时，其中第 7、10、11 节是「高频考点」）：各阶段的脑电波（β、α、θ、睡眠纺锤波、δ，REM 按 β 波记）；用睡眠周期图看 N3 集中在前半夜、REM 越到早上越长；一生中的睡眠；噩梦（REM）vs 夜惊（N3）等睡眠障碍；Freud 的显性内容 vs 隐性内容、认知理论、激活-整合理论、进化理论；清醒梦。
tasks.en: Chapter 5 sections 7-12, sleep and dreams (about 1.5 hours; sections 7, 10 and 11 are High-yield): the brain waves of each stage (beta, alpha, theta, sleep spindles, delta; learn REM as beta); use the sleep-cycle chart to see N3 early in the night and REM growing toward morning; sleep across the lifespan; sleep disorders such as nightmares (REM) vs night terrors (N3); Freud's manifest vs latent content and the cognitive, activation-synthesis and evolutionary theories; lucid dreaming.

tasks.zh: 第 5 章第 13–18 节，药物、催眠和冥想（约 1.5 小时，其中第 13、14、15、17 节是「高频考点」）：耐受性、生理依赖 vs 心理依赖、成瘾、奖赏通路；抑制剂、兴奋剂、致幻剂各有哪些（分类练习；教材把 MDMA 归入兴奋剂、大麻归入致幻剂）；催眠的四个步骤，Hilgard 的分离意识观（隐藏的观察者）vs 社会认知行为观；正念冥想和慈心冥想。
tasks.en: Chapter 5 sections 13-18, drugs, hypnosis and meditation (about 1.5 hours; sections 13, 14, 15 and 17 are High-yield): tolerance, physical vs psychological dependence, addiction and the reward pathway; which drugs are depressants, stimulants or hallucinogens (sorting drill; the textbook puts MDMA with the stimulants and marijuana with the hallucinogens); the four steps of hypnosis and Hilgard's divided consciousness view (the hidden observer) vs the social cognitive behaviour view; mindfulness and lovingkindness meditation.

tasks.zh: 第 5 章第 19 节「讲课重点（简答题）」（约 45 分钟）：注意的三个功能、Stroop 任务和背外侧前额叶皮层、阈下知觉（Eagle 1959 年的图片研究）——讲课把这些放在意识这一讲，教材却在第 4 章，两边都要会；还有睡眠的四个功能、REM 的特点、五种梦的观点、清醒梦的方法、冥想和 α 波。
tasks.en: Chapter 5 section 19, Lecture review for short answers (about 45 minutes): the three functions of attention, the Stroop task and the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, and subliminal perception (Eagle's 1959 picture study), which the lecture puts in Consciousness while the textbook has them in Chapter 4, so learn both; then the four functions of sleep, the features of REM sleep, the five views of dreaming, the lucid-dreaming techniques, and meditation with alpha waves.

tasks.zh: 「闪卡」15 分钟：第 5 章，方向「英→中」。
tasks.en: Flashcards, 15 minutes: Chapter 5, EN to ZH.

label.zh: 第 6 天（11月13日 周五）：第 5 章刷题 + 第 6 章中段（第 5–12 节）
label.en: Day 6 (Fri Nov 13): Chapter 5 practice, Chapter 6 sections 5-12

tasks.zh: 第 5 章刷题（约 2 小时）：在「刷题」里点「只做客观题」，第 5 章「按课练习」大约 74 道全部做完、读解析，再把错题本里第 5 章的题清掉。
tasks.en: Chapter 5 practice (about 2 hours): in Practice, press Objective only, then Practice on the Chapter 5 card, and do all of its roughly 74 questions with their explanations; then clear the Chapter 5 questions from the mistake book.

tasks.zh: 第 5 章简答题（约 45 分钟）：在「刷题」里点「只做主观题」，大约 11 道，先写英文再自评。
tasks.en: Chapter 5 written answers (about 45 minutes): in Practice, press Written only, roughly 11 questions; write in English first, then grade yourself.

tasks.zh: 第 6 章第 5–8 节（约 1 小时，其中第 6、7 节是「高频考点」）：习得的接近性 vs 相倚性；泛化、辨别、消退、自发恢复、更新（在模拟器里先配对、再只给 CS、再休息）；小阿尔伯特（模拟器）、对抗条件作用、厌恶条件作用；安慰剂、免疫系统（Ader）、味觉厌恶（模拟器）、广告、药物习惯化。
tasks.en: Chapter 6 sections 5-8 (about 1 hour; sections 6 and 7 are High-yield): contiguity vs contingency in acquisition; generalization, discrimination, extinction, spontaneous recovery and renewal (in the simulator, pair, then present the CS alone, then rest); Little Albert (simulator), counterconditioning and aversive conditioning; placebos, the immune system (Ader), taste aversion (simulator), advertising and drug habituation.

tasks.zh: 第 6 章第 9–12 节（约 1 小时，第 11 节是「高频考点」）：Thorndike 的效果律；Skinner 箱和塑造；正强化 vs 负强化（负强化不是惩罚），回避学习，习得性无助；初级 vs 次级强化物；操作性条件反射里的泛化、辨别和消退。
tasks.en: Chapter 6 sections 9-12 (about 1 hour; section 11 is High-yield): Thorndike's law of effect; the Skinner box and shaping; positive vs negative reinforcement (negative reinforcement is not punishment), avoidance learning and learned helplessness; primary vs secondary reinforcers; generalization, discrimination and extinction in operant conditioning.

label.zh: 第 7 天（11月14日 周六）：第 6 章后段（第 13–19 节）+ 刷题
label.en: Day 7 (Sat Nov 14): Chapter 6 sections 13-19 and practice

tasks.zh: 第 6 章第 13–15 节（约 1 小时，全是「高频考点」）：四种强化程序（在强化程序演示里把 FR、VR、FI、VI 各试一次，再做生活例子练习；VR 最难消退）；正惩罚 vs 负惩罚、时机、应用行为分析（四象限练习：先问加上还是拿走，再问行为变多还是变少）；Bandura 的 Bobo 玩偶实验和观察学习的四个过程（分类练习）。
tasks.en: Chapter 6 sections 13-15 (about 1 hour; all High-yield): the four schedules (try FR, VR, FI and VI in the schedules demo, then do its everyday examples; VR resists extinction best); positive vs negative punishment, timing and applied behaviour analysis (quadrant drill: first ask added or removed, then more or less likely); Bandura's Bobo doll study and the four processes of observational learning (sorting drill).

tasks.zh: 第 6 章第 16–19 节（约 45 分钟，其中第 16、17 节是「高频考点」）：Tolman 的潜伏学习 vs Köhler 的顿悟学习（分类练习）；本能漂移 vs 准备性（分类练习）；文化、固定型 vs 成长型心态、学习风格的争议；压力与可预测性、控制感、感到改善、发泄渠道。
tasks.en: Chapter 6 sections 16-19 (about 45 minutes; sections 16 and 17 are High-yield): Tolman's latent learning vs Köhler's insight learning (sorting drill); instinctive drift vs preparedness (sorting drill); culture, fixed vs growth mindset and the learning-styles controversy; stress and predictability, control, perceived improvement and outlets for frustration.

tasks.zh: 第 6 章刷题（约 2 小时）：在「刷题」里点「只做客观题」，第 6 章「按课练习」大约 73 道全部做完，再把错题本里第 6 章的题清掉。
tasks.en: Chapter 6 practice (about 2 hours): in Practice, press Objective only, then Practice on the Chapter 6 card, and do all of its roughly 73 questions; then clear the Chapter 6 questions from the mistake book.

tasks.zh: 第 6 章简答题（约 45 分钟）：在「刷题」里点「只做主观题」，大约 12 道，先写英文再自评；特别练找出 UCS、UCR、CS、CR，以及判断是哪种强化或惩罚。
tasks.en: Chapter 6 written answers (about 45 minutes): in Practice, press Written only, roughly 12 questions; write in English first, then grade yourself. Above all, practise naming the UCS, UCR, CS and CR and classifying reinforcement and punishment.

tasks.zh: 「闪卡」15 分钟：第 6 章，方向「英→中」。
tasks.en: Flashcards, 15 minutes: Chapter 6, EN to ZH.

label.zh: 第 8 天（11月15日 周日）：两次模拟考 + 速记 + 早睡
label.en: Day 8 (Sun Nov 15): two mock tests, cheat sheet, early night

tasks.zh: 上午第一次模拟考（50 分钟）：打开「模拟考」，用默认设置（三章全选、30 道选择题、3 道简答题、50 分钟），语言换成「英文练习」，不看笔记、不点“显示中文”，像真考一样一口气做完。题目来自做过的题库，每道都从头想；只因为记得答案才做对的题，也算错题。
tasks.en: Morning, mock test 1 (50 minutes): open the Mock exam with the default settings (all three chapters, 30 multiple-choice questions, 3 short answers, 50 minutes), switch to English practice mode, and work straight through like the real test, without notes or Show Chinese. The questions come from banks you have done, so think each one through; count a question you only remembered as wrong.

tasks.zh: 复盘（约 1 小时）：对照参考答案给简答题自评；看成绩单「按单元」找出最弱的一章，重读它的「高频考点」小节和「考点清单」，再到错题本点「全部重练」。
tasks.en: Review (about 1 hour): grade your short answers against the model answers; use the report's By unit list to find your weakest chapter, reread its High-yield sections and its Exam focus list, then press Retry all in the mistake book.

tasks.zh: 「速记」（约 1 小时）：把第 4–6 章的要点、规则和「易混概念」全部过一遍，每一对都用一句英文说出区别；再看「答题」工具箱里的简答模板（下定义再举例、找出 US/UR/CS/CR、判断是强化还是惩罚）。
tasks.en: Cheat sheet (about 1 hour): go through the key points of Chapters 4-6, the rules and every pair under Easily confused, and say each difference in one English sentence; then read the short-answer templates in the Exam English toolkit (define and give an example, identify the US, UR, CS and CR, classify reinforcement or punishment).

tasks.zh: 下午第二次模拟考（50 分钟）：同样的设置，再随机抽一套卷子（可能有几道和上午重复），同样限时、每道重新想。做完把错题本清一遍。
tasks.en: Afternoon, mock test 2 (50 minutes): the same settings for another random paper (a few questions may repeat), again timed and thought through. Then clear the mistake book.

tasks.zh: 晚上：照 Quercus 公告收拾好要带的东西，定好闹钟，早点睡（第 5 章：睡眠帮助巩固记忆）。万一明天生病：不要开始答题（大纲规定，开始答题以后就不能再申请特殊照顾），在 72 小时内提交 Special Consideration Request（可以用 ACORN 缺席声明作证明，每学期只能用一次）。
tasks.en: Evening: pack what the Quercus announcement asks for, set an alarm and go to bed early (Chapter 5: sleep helps consolidate memories). If you are ill tomorrow, do not start the test (the syllabus says special consideration is not given once you begin a test); submit a Special Consideration Request within 72 hours (the ACORN Absence Declaration can serve as documentation, once per term).

label.zh: 考试当天（11月16日 周一）：上午轻复习，按讲课时间考
label.en: Test day (Mon Nov 16): light review, test in your lecture time

tasks.zh: 上午（最多 1.5 小时，不学新东西）：把错题本里剩下的题再做一遍；「闪卡」三章全选，勾选「只练不熟的卡」；「速记」里的易混概念再看 10 分钟。
tasks.en: Morning (at most 1.5 hours, nothing new): redo what is left in the mistake book; run Flashcards for all three chapters with Only unfamiliar cards; spend 10 minutes on the Easily confused pairs in the Cheat sheet.

tasks.zh: 把三章讲课重点里的英文范文各读一遍（20 分钟）：第 4 章第 20 节、第 5 章第 19 节、第 6 章第 20 节。简答题写法：术语 + 讲课定义 + 一个例子；讲课和教材说法不同时，简答按讲课写（UCS、UCR，四种基本味觉），选择题按教材选（US、UR，umami 是第五种味觉）。
tasks.en: Read the English model answers of the three lecture-review sections once (20 minutes): Chapter 4 section 20, Chapter 5 section 19, Chapter 6 section 20. Short-answer recipe: term + lecture definition + one example. Where the lecture and the textbook differ, write short answers the lecture's way (UCS, UCR, four basic tastes) and choose multiple-choice answers the textbook's way (US, UR, umami as the fifth taste).

tasks.zh: 开考前先分好 50 分钟（参考「答题」工具箱里的策略）：比如约 25 分钟做 30 道选择题（每题不到 1 分钟），剩下的时间写简答，最后留几分钟检查；看到简答题有几道，再调整。选择题所有选项都读完再选；遇到强化和惩罚，先问“加上还是拿走”。
tasks.en: Plan the 50 minutes before you start (see the strategy in the Exam English toolkit): for example, about 25 minutes for the 30 multiple-choice questions (under a minute each), the rest for the short answers, and a few minutes to check; adjust once you see how many short answers there are. Read every option before choosing, and for reinforcement and punishment first ask: added or removed?

tasks.zh: 提前出发，至少提前 10–15 分钟到考场（考场以 Quercus 公告为准）：LEC0101 是上午 11 点的时段，LEC0102 是下午 1 点的时段。祝你顺利！
tasks.en: Leave early and be at the room (as announced on Quercus) at least 10-15 minutes before your lecture time: 11 am for LEC0101, 1 pm for LEC0102. Good luck!

title.zh: 期末复习计划（本站已有的第 4–6 章）
title.en: Final exam plan (Chapters 4-6 in this station)

note.zh: 期末考试在 4 月考试周（具体日期由教务处 Office of the Registrar 安排）：160 道选择题，全部基于教材，占总成绩 33%。大纲没写考多长时间，也没写具体考哪几章，以 Quercus 公告为准。本站目前只有第 4–6 章：第 1–3 章和第 7–16 章还没有收录，在本站加上之前，请用教材自学（每章末的 Summary、Key Terms 和 Quiz Yourself 都很好用）。所以这个计划只安排第 4–6 章。期末全是教材选择题，复习重点放在标着「教材」页码的小节和客观题上；讲课重点小节主要是为平时测验的简答题准备的。万一错过期末：要在 72 小时内向教务处在线递交申请（petition），不走平时测验的 Special Consideration 流程。
note.en: The final exam is in the April exam period (the Office of the Registrar sets the date): 160 multiple-choice questions based on the textbook, worth 33%. The syllabus does not give its length or list the chapters it covers, so check Quercus. The station covers Chapters 4-6 only: Chapters 1-3 and 7-16 are not in the station yet, so study them from the textbook (each chapter's Summary, Key Terms and Quiz Yourself help a lot) until they are added. This plan therefore schedules Chapters 4-6 only. The final is all multiple choice on the textbook, so focus on the sections with Textbook page numbers and on objective practice; the lecture-review sections mainly serve the short answers on the term tests. If you miss the final, file an online petition with the Office of the Registrar within 72 hours; the term-test Special Consideration process does not apply.

label.zh: 测验 2 之后 · 每周例行

tasks.zh: 测验 2 发回后：每道错的选择题，找到它属于第几章哪一节，回去重读那一节，再做那一章的练习题；简答题对照讲课重点里的范文，看差在哪里。大纲规定：觉得书面作答判得不公平，可以在发还后一个月内找判分的人重新评估（重判可能加分，也可能减分）。
tasks.en: When Test 2 comes back, find the chapter and section of each wrong multiple-choice question, reread that section and redo that chapter's practice; compare your short answers with the model answers in the lecture-review sections. The syllabus says that if you think written work was marked unfairly, you can ask the marker to re-evaluate it within one month of getting it back (a re-mark can raise or lower the mark).

tasks.zh: 每周两次、每次 15 分钟：「闪卡」选第 4–6 章、勾选「只练不熟的卡」，再把错题本清一遍，让这三章不生疏。
tasks.en: Twice a week, 15 minutes each: Flashcards for Chapters 4-6 with Only unfamiliar cards, then clear the mistake book, so these chapters stay fresh.

tasks.zh: 后面每一章，都用本站的办法自学：先读教材那一章末的 Summary，再把 Key Terms 做成自己的中英词汇单，最后做 Quiz Yourself（答案印在章末）。
tasks.en: Study each later chapter the station's way on your own: read the chapter's Summary first, turn its Key Terms into your own English-Chinese term list, and finish with Quiz Yourself (the answers are printed at the end of the chapter).

label.zh: 寒假和冬季学期 · 每月一次
label.en: Winter break and winter term: once a month

tasks.zh: 每月一次：在「刷题」里点「只做客观题」，第 4 章、第 5 章、第 6 章各做一次「随机」20 题，错题当天清掉。
tasks.en: Once a month: in Practice, press Objective only and do Random (20 questions) for each of Chapter 4, Chapter 5 and Chapter 6; clear your mistakes the same day.

tasks.zh: 每月一次：在「速记」里挑一章（第 4 章 → 第 5 章 → 第 6 章轮流），把要点和易混概念读一遍，大约 20 分钟。
tasks.en: Once a month: read one chapter of the Cheat sheet (Chapter 4, then 5, then 6 in turn), its key points and confusable pairs, about 20 minutes.

label.zh: 考前第 3 周 · 第一轮：第 4–6 章按顺序过一遍
label.en: 3 weeks before: round 1, Chapters 4-6 in order

tasks.zh: 每天一章（第 4 章、第 5 章、第 6 章）：先读「高频考点」小节，再读「必会」小节；这一轮讲课重点小节只扫一眼，用来对照教材的说法。
tasks.en: One chapter a day (Chapter 4, Chapter 5, Chapter 6): High-yield sections first, then Must know; this time just skim the lecture-review sections to compare them with the textbook.

tasks.zh: 每读完一章，就在「刷题」里点「只做客观题」，把这一章的题全部做一遍，然后清错题本。
tasks.en: After each chapter, press Objective only in Practice and do all of that chapter's questions, then clear the mistake book.

tasks.zh: 在「术语表」里把第 4–6 章大约 260 个术语全部过一遍：期末是 160 道英文选择题，每个词都要一眼认出意思。
tasks.en: Go through all of the roughly 260 terms of Chapters 4-6 in the Glossary: the final is 160 English multiple-choice questions, so you must recognize every term at a glance.

label.zh: 考前第 2 周 · 第二轮：串起来、分清易混概念
label.en: 2 weeks before: round 2, connections and confusable pairs

tasks.zh: 打开首页「知识地图」里的“课与课怎么连起来”，每条连线用一句英文说出来，比如：第 5 章的耐受性，一部分可以用第 6 章的经典条件反射（药物习惯化）来解释。
tasks.en: Open How the lessons connect in The big picture on the home page and say each connection in one English sentence; for example, tolerance in Chapter 5 is partly explained by classical conditioning in Chapter 6 (drug habituation).

tasks.zh: 每天 20 分钟「速记」里的「易混概念」，直到每一对都能用一句话说出区别（rods vs cones、N3 vs REM、负强化 vs 正惩罚、FR vs VR……）。
tasks.en: Every day, 20 minutes on the Easily confused pairs in the Cheat sheet, until you can state each difference in one sentence (rods vs cones, N3 vs REM, negative reinforcement vs positive punishment, FR vs VR...).

tasks.zh: 到错题本点「全部重练」，一直做到清空；再做教材第 4–6 章末的 Quiz Yourself，用章末印的答案核对。
tasks.en: Press Retry all in the mistake book and keep going until it is empty; then do the textbook's Quiz Yourself for Chapters 4-6 and check it with the answer key printed at the end of each chapter.

label.zh: 考前最后一周 · 模拟考

tasks.zh: 模拟考 A：三章全选，「客观题数量」设成 60（本站最多 60 道），「主观题数量」设成 0（期末没有简答题），先不限时；交卷后按成绩单补最弱的一章。
tasks.en: Mock exam A: all three chapters, Objective questions set to 60 (the station's maximum), Written questions set to 0 (the final has no short answers), no time limit at first; then use the report to fix your weakest chapter.

tasks.zh: 模拟考 B 和 C：同样的设置，但按期末的速度限时：期末时长公布后，用“总分钟数 ÷ 160 × 60”算出 60 道题该用多少分钟，选最接近的时间限制。
tasks.en: Mock exams B and C: the same settings, but timed at the final's pace: once the final's length is announced, divide its minutes by 160, multiply by 60, and choose the closest time limit for 60 questions.

tasks.zh: 每天：「速记」看一章（可以打印），错题本清一次。
tasks.en: Every day: one chapter of the Cheat sheet (you can print it) and one pass through the mistake book.

tasks.zh: 「速记」三章全部过一遍，「闪卡」只练不熟的卡；不学新东西。睡足 7–9 小时（第 5 章：睡眠帮助巩固记忆）。
tasks.en: Go through the Cheat sheet for all three chapters and run Flashcards with Only unfamiliar cards; nothing new. Sleep 7-9 hours (Chapter 5: sleep helps consolidate memories).

tasks.zh: 按教务处公布的期末考试安排，再确认一次日期、时间和考场，并照考试规定收拾好要带的东西。
tasks.en: Check the date, time and room again in the official final exam schedule, and pack what the exam rules ask for.

tasks.zh: 万一生病没法考：要在错过考试后 72 小时内向教务处在线递交申请（petition）；没有说明理由的逾期申请不受理。
tasks.en: If illness stops you from writing it: file an online petition with the Office of the Registrar within 72 hours of the missed exam; late petitions are not considered without an explanation.

tasks.zh: 提前到考场。160 道题要稳住节奏：先做有把握的，拿不准的做个标记、最后回来；每道题所有选项都读完；遇到操作性条件反射，先问“加上还是拿走、行为变多还是变少”；术语按教材的说法（US、UR，五种基本味觉）。
tasks.en: Arrive early. Keep a steady pace through 160 questions: answer the sure ones first and flag doubtful ones to come back to; read every option; for operant conditioning ask 'added or removed, more or less likely?'; use the textbook's terms (US, UR, five basic tastes).
